data.body: B5 implementation handoff: standard/mid-tier GPT-5.6-terra worker changed only src/rebar/attest/authorship.py; one edit-to-test attempt. Added -c log.showSignature=false and --no-renames to both point resolvers; intentionally did not add --no-merges. Visible happy-path 1/1 green. Orchestrator restored hidden tests: full oracle 3/3 green. Defect mutation removed the config override from one resolver and both held-out signed/parity tests went RED, then implementation was restored. Tests assert public SHA/parity and the ticket's explicit argv contract, so behavior-preserving renames/extractions would not break them. Proceeding to local review preflight.
